caption: The drawing features a rectangular section with a blue background, decorated with a repeating pattern. The pattern consists of stylized white floral clusters containing three flowers with round centers and jagged-edged petals, accompanied by elongated leaves. These floral motifs are arranged within a diamond-shaped framework formed by diagonal, white leafy garlands crossing each other. Where the garlands intersect, there are small geometric motifs that resemble a four-petal flower with a dark center surrounded by white petals, placed on a short horizontal striped base. The blue background is further detailed with thin, evenly spaced vertical black lines. The design is bordered by a white margin around the patterned area.
title: Wallpaper
